comment: Default autonomy presets for /sprint:full. Approved by operator on 2026-05-18 via AP-20260518-017..020. hard_ceilings[] is informational — scripts/sprint/full.js hardcodes the authoritative enum and rejects any preset bundle that tries to include production_release_approval or paid_service_approval in pre_authorized_approval_levels[]. Operators MAY edit this file to add custom presets, but the hardcoded enum guards the floor.

conservative.description: Halt on anything non-trivial. Only auto-progresses phase boundaries when plan_quality=pass and zero gates fire. Beta ESCALATE halts. Cost gate at $5. Refuses on main.

moderate.description: Default preset. Auto-defers tickets that hit the 3-attempt rule (matches execute.js behavior). Pre-authorizes design-time approvals AND the non-production (staging) release-RECORD step only (release.js prepare — reversible, no deploy, no push). Halts on execution approval, production release, paid services, Beta-ESCALATE. Production release approval and any deploy/push remain HARD-blocked regardless of this preset (the orchestrator's hardcoded FORBIDDEN_PRE_AUTH enum + schema enum forbid production targets). Cost gate at $5. Refuses on main. Note (SP-20260518-007): when the sprint's Plan Contract carries goal_verification.reproduction=executable, scripts/sprint/design.js refuses to advance until every AC in acceptance-criteria.md has a real `verified_by: <file>::<name>` linkage. A moderate-preset /sprint:full run on such a sprint will halt at Phase 2 (design) if the linkage is missing — author the fixtures (or set reproduction=not_applicable with a non-empty justification) before resuming. Backward-compat: pre-Sprint-A Plan Contracts with no goal_verification field are unaffected.

aggressive.description: Maximum autonomy within hard ceilings. Pre-authorizes execution + staging releases. Auto-defers repeated_failure. Allows --allow-main override. Still halts on production deploy, paid services, Beta ESCALATE, destructive actions, scope expansion. Cost gate at $5.
